manual_activity: A qualified operator executes this row's own Common Refcode change/default cycle through KVM, captures each page/POST phase and retains physical recovery access.

Project versus factory default oracle and one safe reversible refcode change with dependencies

Preserve logs and inventory; do not reuse row 2177 evidence

Guide manual checkpoints and collect row-specific screenshots, POST timing, inventory and preserved logs
Compare retained/restored effective state without hardware verdict

engineer_actions: Approve distinct change-default coverage, exact project/factory defaults and reversible refcode value
Approve cross-subsystem inventory, reboot/error criteria and recovery
